base_member_text: [L301] (LOW/transport/fragility) The default CONFIG_GUESS_URL uses plain HTTP for downloading build tooling, so the script has no transport-integrity guarantee for that downloaded file.
audit_member_text: [L301,L1120,L1128-L1131] (HIGH/download-integrity) The optional download replaces executable config.guess from an unauthenticated HTTP URL without verifying its content, and curl does not reject HTTP error responses.

base_member_text: [L1311-L1315] (MED/error-handling) The second aclocal invocation after libtoolize records its exit status but never checks it before continuing to autoconf, so a failed regenerated macro scan can be masked.
audit_member_text: [L1312-L1314] (MED/error-handling) The second aclocal invocation saves its failure status but never checks it before continuing with configuration generation.

base_member_text: [L205-L207] (MED/logic/defect) The version-check fallback tests whether _cur_minor is empty but then assigns _cur_major=0, so a current version lacking a minor component can have its major component incorrectly reset.
audit_member_text: [L205-L206] (MED/version-comparison) The empty-minor check resets _cur_major instead of checking whether _cur_major is empty, misclassifying a major-only version.

adversarial.rationale: The complete version_check procedure converts a major-only current version such as 3 to 3., then resets its nonempty major to zero at trunk/autogen.sh:205-206; the following fallback only sets the minor and does not restore the major. Executing the extracted procedure in memory rejected current 3 against minimum 2.52 but accepted 3.0, and the callers at lines 555-560, 596-601 and 698-703 neither require a minor component nor append one.

base_member_text: [L263] (MED/stale-path/contract) LIBTOOL_M4 is hard-coded to misc/libtool.m4 even though this shard’s generated autotools include is m4/libtool.m4, so the libtool-failure recovery path may silently lack its intended project macro file.

[L1001-L1002,L1026] (MED/path/logic) The Makefile.am existence checks construct dirname from "$CONFIGURE/Makefile.am" rather than the configure template’s containing directory, so they do not reliably test the top-level Makefile.am location.

[L1127-L1130] (LOW/quoting/robustness) The download command and destination move leave the URL/auxiliary-directory expansion partly unquoted, making paths or values containing shell-significant whitespace fragile.

audit_member_text: [L80-L86] (LOW/minimum-version-mismatch) The default Autoconf minimum is 2.52 although configure.ac explicitly requires at least 2.59.
[L259-L260,L495,L969] (MED/path-quoting) Unquoted script and configuration paths are split on whitespace, preventing reliable operation from paths containing spaces.

[L247-L250,L1077-L1089,L1170] (MED/working-directory-contract) The script can locate configure.ac beside itself when invoked elsewhere but still initializes and runs Autotools in the caller's working directory.

[L780,L862-L873] (MED/backup-error-handling) Backup creation and restoration are unchecked and the backup is deleted even after a failed restore, undermining protection against clobbering COPYING or INSTALL.

[L1105-L1107,L1128-L1138] (MED/download-error-handling) ret records tool availability rather than failed download status and is forced to zero after an unchecked move, so download or installation failures can escape the warning and cleanup.

[L1227,L1253-L1254,L1405,L1487] (MED/retry-argument-contract) libtool_failure restarts autogen with its function arguments, passing captured tool error output as command-line options instead of the original script arguments.
[L1558-L1572] (MED/exit-status) A missing resulting configure script produces only a warning and leaves a successful shell exit status.
